purpose: Diagnose baseline weaknesses before validating a continuous adaptive Gaussian hierarchy with INLA
donor_split: Reuse the disjoint 40-reference-donor splits; no donor identities published
ld_aware_definition: Maximum one-to-one matching of selected to causal markers using population-specific study LD; report each population separately
failure_policy: Keep failures and nonconvergence in denominators; publish fit statuses; calibration failures block that arm rather than silently assigning scores

inla.execution_gate: Baseline sensitivities and fresh validation must pass independent numerical audits first
inla.dataset_source: First 20 replicates of null/shared/heterogeneous from the fresh validation namespace, prespecified without outcome selection

interpretation: Global-null error calibration is not nonnull FDR control; oracle residual variance and in-sample LD are diagnostic controls, not real-data inputs
scope: Six sparse regions on one chromosome, small fixed donor panels and a quantitative synthetic trait; not genome-wide or clinical validation
